profile.name: Francisco Bolatti
profile.title: Full Stack Engineer
profile.subtitle: React · TypeScript · Next.js · Laravel
profile.summary: Mid-level Full Stack Engineer with 5+ years of experience at Empretienda and Ualá, working on an e-commerce SaaS platform serving 250,000+ stores and Ualá's fintech web app. Grew from Frontend Developer to Full Stack Engineer, focused on React, TypeScript, Redux and Next.js, with hands-on experience in Laravel, SQL, Mercado Pago, Auth0 and Braze.

highlights: Built and maintained key features in Ualá's main web app and the Empretienda platform.
Refactored and optimized the checkout flow, prioritizing performance during traffic peaks.
Contributed to automatic subscription billing with Mercado Pago on 250,000+ stores.
Implemented secure authentication flows with Auth0 and event tracking with Amplitude.
Built Eris, Elara, and Mimas e-commerce templates using Laravel/PHP.
Developed interactive components in the store control panel and checkout flow.
Converted Figma prototypes into interactive, responsive React code with pixel-perfect precision.
